[package]
name = "oxide-text"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "A fast, cross-platform markdown-first text editor that still reads code with syntax highlighting."
license = "MIT"

[[bin]]
name = "oxide-text"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
eframe = { version = "0.33", default-features = false, features = ["default_fonts", "glow", "wayland", "x11"] }
egui = "0.33"
syntect = { version = "5.3", default-features = false, features = ["default-fancy"] }
pulldown-cmark = { version = "0.13", default-features = false, features = ["html"] }
rfd = "0.16"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png"] }

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = "thin"

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 2

input.content:
# Oxide Text — plan documents

A plan for a cross-platform text editor that keeps the feel of a fast, keyboard-driven
programmer's editor, but puts **writing and formatting Markdown** first, while still
**reading code with syntax colouring**.

> Status: **planning only.** Nothing is being built yet. These documents describe how
> the app is meant to work so the plan can be refined before any building starts.

## Read in this order

| Document | What it covers | Who it's for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [PLAN.md](PLAN.md) | What the app does, screen by screen, and how each feature behaves | Everyone |
| [SHORTCUTS.md](SHORTCUTS.md) | Every command and its keyboard shortcut | Everyone |
| [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) | How it would be built: technology, parts, cross-platform notes | Whoever builds it |
| [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) | Suggested build order in stages, and open questions to decide | Everyone |

## One-paragraph summary

One window. A side bar on the left (open files, document outline, project folder),
tabs across the top, the editor in the middle with line numbers and a small "minimap"
on the right, and a status bar along the bottom. Markdown files get a formatting bar
and a live preview beside the editor (or instead of it). Code files open with colours
for their language and can be locked into a read-only "reading mode". Everything is
reachable from the keyboard through a searchable command list.

## About the draft code in `src/`

Early sketches of a few parts (colours, Markdown formatting actions, the preview, the
command list) were written before the decision to plan first. They are **not built and
not wired together**; treat them as notes that show one possible way to do the work
described in ARCHITECTURE.md. They can be kept, changed or deleted when building starts.

# Commands and shortcuts

"Ctrl" means **Cmd** on macOS. Commands without a shortcut are still available from the
menus and the Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P).

## File

| Command | Shortcut |
| --- | --- |
| New | Ctrl+N |
| Open… | Ctrl+O |
| Open Folder… | Ctrl+Shift+O |
| Save | Ctrl+S |
| Save As… | Ctrl+Shift+S |
| Save All | — |
| Close Tab | Ctrl+W |
| Export as HTML… | Ctrl+Shift+E |
| Quit | Ctrl+Q |

## Edit and find

| Command | Shortcut |
| --- | --- |
| Undo / Redo | Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y (Ctrl+Shift+Z) |
| Find | Ctrl+F |
| Find and Replace | Ctrl+H |
| Find Next / Previous | F3 / Shift+F3 |
| Indent / Outdent | Tab / Shift+Tab, or Ctrl+] / Ctrl+[ |

## Format (Markdown files)

| Command | Shortcut |
| --- | --- |
| Bold | Ctrl+B |
| Italic | Ctrl+I |
| Strikethrough | Ctrl+Shift+X |
| Inline code | Ctrl+` |
| Link | Ctrl+K |
| Image | Ctrl+Shift+K |
| Heading 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 | Ctrl+1 / 2 / 3 / 4 |
| Normal text | Ctrl+0 |
| Bulleted list | Ctrl+Shift+U |
| Numbered list | Ctrl+Shift+N |
| Task list | Ctrl+Shift+T |
| Quote | Ctrl+Shift+Q |
| Code block | Ctrl+Shift+C |
| Table | — |
| Divider | — |
| Align table | Ctrl+Alt+T |
| Clean up document | Ctrl+Shift+F |

## View

| Command | Shortcut |
| --- | --- |
| Toggle side bar | Ctrl+\ |
| Toggle minimap | — |
| Toggle formatting bar | — |
| Toggle word wrap | Alt+Z |
| Editor only / Split / Preview only | Ctrl+Alt+1 / 2 / 3 |
| Cycle preview | Ctrl+Shift+V |
| Toggle read-only | — |
| Dark / Light theme | — |
| Larger / smaller text | Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- |
| Reset text size | — |

## Go

| Command | Shortcut |
| --- | --- |
| Command Palette | Ctrl+Shift+P |
| Go to File | Ctrl+P |
| Go to Heading | Ctrl+R |
| Go to Line | Ctrl+G |
| Next / previous tab | Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab |
| Set syntax (language) | — (click the language in the status bar) |

## Help

| Command | Shortcut |
| --- | --- |
| Markdown cheat sheet | F1 |
| About | — |

### Notes on choices

- Ctrl+Shift+N, Ctrl+Shift+T and Ctrl+Shift+Q are used for lists/quotes here; some other
  editors use them for "new window", "reopen closed tab" and "quit". Worth confirming.
- Shortcuts with Shift are checked before the same shortcut without Shift, so
  Ctrl+Shift+P never also triggers Ctrl+P.

# Build order and open questions

## Suggested stages

Each stage ends with something usable that can be tried and judged.

### Stage 1 — A plain editor that runs everywhere
- Window, menu bar, tabs, status bar, dark/light theme.
- New / open / save / save as / close with "unsaved changes" prompts; drag and drop.
- Line numbers, current line, word wrap toggle, text size.
- `--screenshot` option for automatic checks.

### Stage 2 — Markdown writing
- Markdown colouring in the editor (bigger headings, coloured emphasis, list markers).
- Formatting bar, Format menu and shortcuts for every action in PLAN.md §3.2.
- List and quote continuation on Enter; Tab/Shift+Tab indenting.
- Align table and Clean up document.

### Stage 3 — Preview
- Edit / Split / Preview views; live preview with tables, task checkboxes (clickable),
  quotes, code blocks.
- Export as HTML.

### Stage 4 — Code reading
- Language detection and colouring for code files and fenced code blocks.
- Set Syntax picker; read-only mode.
- Minimap.

### Stage 5 — Finding and navigating
- Find / replace bar with highlighted matches.
- Command Palette, Go to File, Go to Heading, Go to Line.
- Side bar: open files, outline, folder tree.

### Stage 6 — Polish
- Welcome tab, cheat sheet, About.
- Settings and open tabs remembered between sessions (if chosen).
- Release builds for Windows, macOS and Linux.

## Open questions to decide

| # | Question | Options | Current assumption |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Editing style | Plain Markdown with colours + preview / WYSIWYG that hides the marks / both | Plain + preview |
| 2 | Default view for Markdown | Split / Edit only / Preview only | Split |
| 3 | Images in preview | Show real images from disk / placeholder with alt text | Placeholder (v1) |
| 4 | Export formats | HTML only / also PDF / also Word (.docx) | HTML only |
| 5 | Remember session | Reopen last tabs & settings / start fresh | Not decided |
| 6 | Custom fonts | Built-in only / let user pick system fonts | Built-in only |
| 7 | Spell-check | None / basic English / multiple languages | None (v1) |
| 8 | Files changed outside the app | Ignore / warn / auto-reload | Ignore (v1) |
| 9 | Line endings | Keep as-is / show in status bar / allow converting | Keep as-is |
| 10 | Non-UTF-8 files | Refuse / open read-only with warning / detect encoding | Read-only with warning |
| 11 | Huge files (> 10 MB) | Normal / read-only without colours | Read-only without colours |
| 12 | Shortcut clashes (Ctrl+Shift+N/T/Q) | Keep for lists/quote / match other editors | Keep for lists/quote |
| 13 | Extra Markdown | Math (LaTeX), diagrams (Mermaid), front-matter, footnotes | Footnotes only |
| 14 | Name and icon | "Oxide Text" placeholder / something else | Placeholder |

## What isn't known about the original

The original program wasn't looked inside (clean room), and no picture of it running
was available, so its exact colours and proportions weren't copied. The layout here
(side bar, tabs, minimap, bottom find bar, command palette) follows the general style of
fast programmer's editors. Adding a screenshot of the look you want would let the plan
pin down colours and spacing.
